assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodic lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.

Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, prolonged rhythm monitoring is indicated to detect asymptomatic or symptomatic atrial fibrillation episodes that may require anticoagulation management.
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is CPT 93226.
The service is not covered under reason code PR-204.
